story.heading: About Cynosural
story.intro: Cynosural is an independent AI research lab based in Madrid, Spain. We research agents that can pursue long-term goals, adapt to changing circumstances, and evaluate how their actions affect themselves and others.
story.research: Our current work draws on probabilistic modeling and decision theory to develop tools for reasoning under uncertainty. Our broader interests include reinforcement learning and multiagent systems, with a focus on how agents learn from experience, gather and exchange information, and coordinate their decisions over long time horizons.
story.approach: We believe in advancing this research through openness, so others can build on them. We are currently self-funded, using our own resources to develop the lab and its research.
